boot_prose: When this machine last started, and whether the stack came back with it.
boot_started_unsaid: This machine does not say when it last started.
boot_failing: The stack has not come back since {since}.
boot_failing_for: The stack has not come back since {since}, for {count} starts.
boot_declined: A run after the last start started nothing: {why}
boot_none: Nothing has been kept about starting yet.
boot_none_after: No check ran after the last start. The newest one below was after an earlier start.
boot_passed: The stack came back, tunnel and forwarded port included.
boot_failed: The stack, or its tunnel, did not come back.
boot_waiting: The rest came back, and one part waits for its install from this build.
boot_outcome_other: lemonfiber said something this console does not know how to show.
boot_tunnel_lost: The tunnel did not come back: {said}
boot_tunnel_other: The tunnel stands in a way this console does not know how to show.
boot_port: Forwarded port before the start: {was}. Now: {now}.
boot_port_unpushed: Not every download client takes peers on that port yet.
watcher_prose: What watches the stack from outside it, and what each of its monitors sees.
watcher_nobody: Nothing watches the stack from outside.
watcher_blind: The watcher does not answer: {why} What it sees cannot be shown, so this is not an all-clear.
watcher_kind_http: Asks a web address and expects an answer.
watcher_kind_keyword: Asks a web address and looks for a word in the answer.
watcher_kind_port: Opens a connection to a port.
watcher_kind_heartbeat: Waits for a check-in each interval.
watcher_kind_other: Checks in a way this console does not know how to show.
watcher_pending: Failing since {since}, not yet often enough to alarm.
watcher_state_other: Seeing something this console does not know how to show, since {since}.
watcher_never_read: It has never taken a reading.
watcher_heartbeat: Expects a check-in every {every}, and waits {grace} more before it alarms.
watcher_never_checked_in: It has never been checked in with.
watcher_path_household: Watches the address the household is handed.
watcher_path_internal: Watches the address the stack's own network reaches.
watcher_instead: Asked to watch {wanted}, and watches {watches} instead.
queue_prose: Downloads that stopped moving, and what lemonfiber does about each after enough passes find it so.
queue_healing_on: Healing is on: a download that strikes out is acted on.
queue_healing_off: Healing only looks: nothing is acted on.
queue_rule: A download is acted on after {count} passes in a row find it unhealthy, and is left alone for {grace} after it is added.
queue_classified: The queue was last looked at on {when}.
queue_never_classified: The queue has never been looked at.
queue_incomplete: This list may be short, because something could not be read.
queue_none: Nothing in the queue is unhealthy.
queue_stalled: Stalled: connected, with nothing moving and nothing to move it.
queue_slow: Slow: moving, but so slowly it would take longer than allowed.
queue_failed: Failed: the client or the program that asked for it gave up.
queue_metadata: Stuck before it found out what it is.
queue_orphaned: Left behind: no program is waiting for it.
queue_wedge_other: Unhealthy in a way this console does not know how to show.
queue_strikes: Found unhealthy {count} passes in a row.
queue_act_other: do something this console does not know how to show
queue_taken_other: {act}: came to something this console does not know how to show
queue_run_rehearsed: A rehearsal: nothing was acted on.
notify_prose: Where alerts are delivered, how far each way is proven, and what it last delivered.
notify_unconfigured: No way to deliver alerts is set up, so nothing is delivered anywhere.
notify_ready: At least one way is proven, and none failed its last delivery.
notify_degraded: One of the ways alerts go failed its last delivery or its test.
notify_unreachable: No way alerts go is taking messages.
notify_state_other: Delivery stands in a way this console does not know how to show.
notify_unread: What is kept about {backend} could not be read: {because}
notify_kind_webhook: An address each message is posted to
notify_kind_other: A way this console does not know how to show
notify_chosen_operator: Chosen by whoever runs the house.
notify_unproven: No test sent to it has been seen arriving.
notify_proven: A test was seen arriving on {when}.
notify_held: Nothing is delivered to it until it is proven again: {why}
notify_hosted: Hosted on {host}, not in the household. What leaves for it: {leaves}.
notify_sent: On {when}, {kind}: taken, and not seen arriving.
notify_outcome_other: On {when}, {kind}: came to something this console does not know how to show.
